Ghana Immigration Service  ·  Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Official Government Guidance
1 About the Ghana ETA
The Ghana Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) is an online travel authorization for eligible travellers who do not require a Ghana visa but must obtain authorization before travelling to Ghana.
The ETA is issued through the official Ghana eVisa/ETA portal to travellers whose eligibility result is "ETA Required." The application process is completed online.
Applicants should provide accurate information, upload genuine and legible supporting documents, and monitor their registered email address and application dashboard.
The ETA regime applies to nationals of:
All African Union (AU) member states.
All ECOWAS member states.
Countries holding a current bilateral visa waiver agreement with Ghana.
The definitive eligibility list is maintained by the Director, Visa & Permits in collaboration with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and is confirmed using the official Eligibility Checker.
The ETA is free of charge The ETA is not a visa — it is a free pre-travel security authorisation for eligible nationals.
There is no fee to apply.
The maximum permitted stay under the ETA is 90 days from the date of entry.
Use the official Eligibility Checker before applying for an ETA.
If the result is "ETA Required," proceed to Travel Authorization and complete the ETA application described in this guide.
If a different result is returned — Visa-Free or eVisa Required — follow the applicable route instead of applying for an ETA.
Eligibility depends on nationality, passport type and applicable government policy, and may change.
Always check the current result before applying or travelling.
Do not assume eligibility Nationality alone may not be sufficient to determine the applicable route.
Use the current eligibility checker before applying or travelling.
3 ETA Application Steps
The ETA application follows the steps below.
Each step is described in more detail in the sections that follow.
Step Section Requirement
1 Eligibility Applicant completes the Eligibility Checker and receives "ETA Required."
2 Travel Authorization Applicant selects "Proceed to Travel Authorization."
3 Applicant Applying for yourself?
4 Personal information Date of birth, nationality, country of residence, email and phone number.
5 Passport Passport number, country of issue, date of issue and date of expiry.
6 Uploads Passport photograph and passport biodata page.
7 Purpose Tourism; leisure; business meetings; conferences; visiting friends or relatives; official government visit; medical care; transit; other.
8 Travel City of departure, airline, flight number, intended date of travel and port of entry.
9 Accommodation Select accommodation type and provide the required accommodation information.
10 Health Yellow Fever vaccination information and whether the applicant has visited a country subject to a public health alert.
11 Security Answer the security questions.
12 Declaration Review, confirm and submit.
4 Applicant Information
Indicate whether you are applying for yourself.
Applying for yourself — Yes / No.
If you are applying on behalf of someone else, you will need their information to complete the sections below.
Country of residence.
Use an active email address — this is used for correspondence, notifications and your ETA outcome.
5 Passport Information
Provide your passport details exactly as they appear on your passport.
Check your passport validity Confirm your passport remains valid for your intended travel before applying.
Follow the current guidance on the official portal for the applicable minimum validity.
6 Passport Photo and Biodata Page
Upload a recent colour passport-style photograph that clearly shows your full face, together with your passport biodata page.
The photograph should meet the guidance below and the portal's current upload specifications.
